STATUS: FAILED
SUMMARY: The change adds a parallel token-refresh path and reworks the session hook.
Two defects block the merge: concurrent 401 responses can race the refresh call in the
interceptor, and the session hook keeps polling the previous account after an account
switch. Both fixes are local and cheap.

  CATEGORY: bug

  MESSAGE: Concurrent 401 responses each trigger their own refresh call because in-flight refreshes are not deduplicated.
  SUGGESTION: Share one in-flight refresh promise keyed on the request.
- SEVERITY: medium
